About ⅔ cup

Two thirds of a cup is 10 tablespoons plus 2 teaspoons. Many measuring sets don't include a ⅔ cup, which is one more reason to weigh.

A cup measures volume, so ⅔ cup weighs a different amount for every ingredient. Dense ingredients like honey and peanut butter weigh far more than light ones like oats and cocoa. For dry ingredients the numbers here assume the cup is spooned in and leveled; brown sugar is packed.

Questions

How many grams is ⅔ cup of all-purpose flour?

⅔ cup of all-purpose flour weighs about 80 g (2.82 oz), based on 120 g per cup.

How many grams is ⅔ cup of granulated sugar?

⅔ cup of granulated sugar weighs about 133 g (4.7 oz), based on 200 g per cup.

How many grams is ⅔ cup of butter?

⅔ cup of butter weighs about 151 g (5.33 oz), based on 227 g per cup.
